اشتريا (form VIII)
# اِشْتَرَيَا (ištarayā) /iʃ.ta.ra.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِشْتَرَى (ištarā)
# اُشْتُرِيَا (ušturiyā) /uʃ.tu.ri.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِشْتَرَى (ištarā)
# اِشْتَرِيَا (ištariyā) /iʃ.ta.ri.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِشْتَرَى (ištarā)
